name: email-call-intro
objective: Introduce Email by In-Sync to a potential B2B client, spark interest in the product's capabilities, and secure a follow-up demo meeting.
opening: Hi [Contact Name], this is [Your Name] calling from In-Sync — hope I'm catching you at a good time! I'm reaching out because we've built a product called Email that's helping B2B teams streamline and supercharge their email communication workflows. I'd love to take just two minutes to share what we're doing and see if it might be a fit for your team.
key_points: Email by In-Sync is a purpose-built B2B email platform designed to help teams send smarter, more personalized outreach at scale without sacrificing deliverability or compliance.
Unlike generic email tools, Email integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows and CRM, giving your team a unified view of every conversation and follow-up in one place.
Our platform features advanced automation, real-time analytics, and AI-assisted email composition so your team spends less time writing and more time closing deals.
We've helped businesses reduce email response time by up to 40% and significantly improve open and reply rates through intelligent sequencing and personalization.
Getting started is quick and low-friction — most teams are fully onboarded within a week, and we offer dedicated support throughout the entire setup process.

objection_handling.We already use another email tool: That's completely understandable — most teams we speak with are already using something. What we typically find is that Email by In-Sync fills the gaps those tools leave behind, especially around B2B-specific automation and deliverability. Would you be open to a quick 20-minute demo just to see how it compares?
objection_handling.Now isn't a good time, we're too busy: Absolutely, I respect that — and that's actually exactly why teams like yours reach out to us. When you're busy, the last thing you need is email chaos slowing you down. I'm not asking for much right now — just a 20-minute call at a time that works for you so you can decide if it's worth exploring further.
objection_handling.We don't have the budget for a new tool: I totally hear you — budget is always a consideration. The good news is that Email is designed to replace or consolidate multiple tools you might already be paying for, which often results in a net cost saving. Could we at least explore whether it makes financial sense before ruling it out?

closing: I really appreciate you taking the time to chat today, [Contact Name] — it sounds like there could be a genuine fit here worth exploring. Can we lock in a 20-minute demo this week or next so you can see Email in action with your specific use case in mind? I'll send over a calendar invite right after this call.
